description: This file defines a BracketMatchingService class that manages bracket pairing logic for code autocompletion, including handling accepted completions and streaming output with bracket matching.

classes.name: BracketMatchingService
classes.description: A service class that handles bracket matching logic for code autocompletion, including tracking open brackets from previous completions and processing streams to match brackets.

methods.name: handleAcceptedCompletion
methods.description: Processes a completed code snippet to track unmatched opening brackets for future autocompletion context.

methods.name: stopOnUnmatchedClosingBracket
methods.description: An asynchronous generator that streams code, stopping when an unmatched closing bracket is encountered, considering previous bracket context.
